title: Fixture harness plus three seed fixtures
acceptance: A helper in the SwiftReadability test target loads a frozen HTML fixture and its expected-result JSON from disk
Fixtures are bundled as test resources so `swift test` finds them with no network access and no simulator

Three fixtures land: a Wikipedia article, a Paul Graham table-era page, and a

-paragraph page
Each asserts title, word count, and block-type mix against the frozen expectation
A regression in ArticleExtractor or HTMLParser fails at least one fixture
notes: Realigned to the SPM layout after D-0001. Unblocks T-0006 (~30 fixtures). Mechanical and self-verifying: good factory work.

history.detail: acceptance and touches moved from the abandoned StacksTests iOS target to the SwiftReadability package
